firm_data.firm_description: Porter Law Group is a Legal Services company specializing in personal injury law. They have consistently achieved top recoveries for individuals who suffered serious personal injury and other financial loss.
notable_facts: The firm's mission is to provide clients the very best in service and results with core values of integrity, service, and attention to detail.
Mike and Eric crossed paths representing different parties in a complex personal injury case and joined forces to build the firm.

email.subject: AI for Porter Law Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Maureen,

Porter Law Group has built an impressive track record since 2009 achieving top recoveries across medical malpractice, auto accidents, and complex personal injury cases. That kind of results-driven practice demands precision systems that most platforms simply don't support.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding into the Syracuse region to meet firms doing exactly what you do. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete with BigLaw without compromise.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
